## About
Precision Auto Solutions is a car repair shop in Miami where BMW owners bring everything from small repairs to full builds. One reviewer called us the best BMW shop in south Florida, and we take that seriously every time a car rolls in.
Tony, the owner, stays involved in the work that goes on each car, and the team takes time to answer questions and explain options. We want you to know what is being done and why, and to get your car back on the road without it sitting around.

## Services
- Repairs, engine and transmission swaps: Work ranging from small repairs to engine and transmission swaps.
- Clutch work: Clutch jobs, including upgraded clutches and fresh fluids.
- Exhaust installation and wiring: Exhaust installs and the wiring that goes with them, along with other mods.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We are closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can you work on my BMW?
A: Yes. BMW owners bring us everything from small repairs to bigger jobs and upgrades.
